blocks.text: 9. derste şu an olanı söyledin: I am reading. Şimdi geçmişte bir anda ne olduğunu anlatacaksın: «çizgi roman okuyordum», «sen aradığında botlarımı temizliyordum», «ben konuşurken çiçekleri kokluyordu».

examples.en: I was reading a comic book.
They were doing a jigsaw puzzle.
I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.
She was sniffing the flowers while I was talking.

blocks.text: Türkçede tek ek yeter: «okuyordum». İngilizcede iki parça gerekir: was ya da were ve -ing'li eylem. Bu, 9. dersin geçmişe taşınmış hali: am / is / are yerine was / were. I was reading.

examples.en: I was reading a comic book.
She was using a colouring book.
I was cooking fried rice.
We were eating a spring roll.
They were watching the soap bubbles.

fixes.wrong: I was read a comic book.
fixes.right: I was reading a comic book.
I was reading a comic book.

fixes.wrong: They was doing a jigsaw puzzle.
fixes.right: They were doing a jigsaw puzzle.

drill.why: they ile geçmişte were; -ing zaten var.

blocks.text: Türkçede olumsuzluk ekin içindedir: «oynamıyordum». İngilizcede not, was ya da were'den sonra gelir: I wasn't playing, they weren't watching. -ing kalır.

examples.en: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.
I wasn't writing in the homework diary.
I wasn't watching the robin.

fixes.wrong: I didn't playing on the bouncy castle.
fixes.right: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.

fixes.wrong: I wasn't play on the bouncy castle.
fixes.right: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.

blocks.text: Türkçede soru sondaki «mu» ile yapılır: «oynuyor muydun?». İngilizcede was ya da were başa geçer: Were you playing in the paddling pool? did burada yok: Did you playing yanlış.

examples.en: Were you playing in the paddling pool?
Was he jumping on the trampoline?
Were you using the workbook?
Was he watching the owl?

fixes.wrong: Did you playing in the paddling pool?
fixes.right: Were you playing in the paddling pool?

fixes.wrong: You were playing in the paddling pool?
fixes.right: Were you playing in the paddling pool?

drill.question: O sırada baykuşu izleyip izlemediğini sor. Hangisi doğru?
drill.explain: -ing ile soru was ya da were ile başlar, did ile değil.

blocks.text: Bu biçim arka planı çizmek için kullanılır: hikâye başladığında insanlar ne yapıyordu. I was changing a flat tyre — «patlak lastiği değiştiriyordum». Bu ayrı bir olay değil, süren bir şey.

examples.en: I was changing a flat tyre.
He was checking the windscreen wiper.
We were cleaning the rear-view mirror.
She was packing the nappy bag.

blocks.text: Süren bir işin ortasında bir şey olduysa: süren iş was / were + -ing, olay ise when'den sonra basit geçmiş: I was cleaning my boots when you called. Arama kısaydı, temizliği böldü.

examples.en: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.
She was packing her ballet flats when I called.
We were looking for an insole when you arrived.
She was drawing a piece of driftwood when I arrived.
examples.translation: Ben geldiğimde bir parça deniz odunu çiziyordu.

fixes.wrong: I cleaned my ankle boots when you were calling.
fixes.right: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.

fixes.wrong: When you called I cleaning my boots.
fixes.right: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.

blocks.text: while — Türkçedeki «-ken». İki iş aynı anda sürüyorsa kullanılır ve iki tarafta da was / were + -ing olur: She was sniffing the flowers while I was talking — «ben konuşurken çiçekleri kokluyordu».

examples.en: I was looking up while you were taking a photo.
examples.translation: Sen fotoğraf çekerken ben yukarı bakıyordum.

examples.en: She was sniffing the flowers while I was talking.
We were giggling while he was telling the story.
I was cutting celery while you were cooking.
examples.translation: Sen yemek yaparken ben kereviz doğruyordum.

blocks.text: Süren işi bölen kısa olay — when + basit geçmiş: when you called («sen aradığında»). Aynı anda süren uzun iş — while + was / were + -ing: while you were cooking («sen yemek yaparken»).

examples.en: We were watching a wasp when you called.
examples.translation: Sen aradığında bir eşek arısını izliyorduk.

examples.en: I was watching a butterfly while you were taking a photo.
examples.translation: Sen fotoğraf çekerken ben bir kelebeği izliyordum.

examples.en: I was turning around when you called my name.

drill.why: İki iş aynı anda sürüyordu: while.

fixes.wrong: I was read a comic book.
fixes.right: I was reading a comic book.

fixes.wrong: They was doing a jigsaw puzzle.
fixes.right: They were doing a jigsaw puzzle.

fixes.wrong: I didn't playing on the bouncy castle.
fixes.right: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.

fixes.wrong: Did you playing in the paddling pool?
fixes.right: Were you playing in the paddling pool?

fixes.wrong: You were playing in the paddling pool?
fixes.right: Were you playing in the paddling pool?

fixes.wrong: I cleaned my ankle boots when you were calling.
fixes.right: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.

blocks.text: Geçmişte süren iş — was / were + -ing. Onu bölen kısa olay — when'den sonra basit geçmiş. did, -ing ile birlikte kullanılmaz.
Sürüyordu — was / were + -ing. «-mıyordu» — wasn't / weren't. Soru — Was…? Were…? Böldü — when + basit geçmiş. Aynı anda — while + was / were + -ing.

examples.en: I was filling a spray bottle.
Were you taking a photo of the woodpecker?
I was looking at a starfish when you called.
examples.translation: Sen aradığında bir deniz yıldızına bakıyordum.

examples.en: I was using a glue stick while you were drawing.
examples.translation: Sen çizerken ben stick yapıştırıcı kullanıyordum.
